---
name: Bug Report 🐛
about: Help improve AgentSpace by reporting a clear and reproducible bug
title: "[Bug]: <short summary>"
labels: bug, needs-triage
assignees: ''

---

## 🔍 Summary
Describe the bug and its impact on the AgentSpace ecosystem.

## ✅ Expected Behavior
What should have happened?

## ❌ Actual Behavior
What happened instead?

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Clone or run AgentSpace
2. Run command or interact with a specific agent
3. Observe the unexpected behavior

## 📋 Logs or Screenshots
Paste logs or attach screenshots that help clarify the bug.

## 🧠 Affected Components
- [ ] Agent core logic
- [ ] Agent registry or metadata
- [ ] Dev CLI or tooling
- [ ] JSON spec files
- [ ] UI interface (if any)
- [ ] Docs or examples

## 🌐 Environment Info
- OS: `uname -a`
- Python version: `python --version`
- Node.js version: `node --version`

## 🧩 Suggested Fix (Optional)
Do you have an idea for a fix?

## 📎 Additional Context
Anything else we should know?
